question: Does demo/cam01.mp4 support a manually verifiable image-space line-crossing example?

evidence.visual_inspection: Frames 0/240/480/705 (640x360 tiles) show the background, horizon and water area changing position: the camera pans/moves through the scene (handheld or panning telephoto stock footage).

reason: A fixed pixel-space line is not attached to the ground in a moving view, so a counted crossing would mix person motion with camera motion and could not be verified as a person crossing a physical boundary. The scene is also a dense, continuous crowd without an identifiable doorway, portal or marked boundary.
decision: No crossing is configured for cam-01. Image-space line crossing is implemented generically (configured per camera, source-time based, idempotent, persisted) and covered by tests, so it can be enabled on fixed-camera footage with a defined boundary.
external_input_required: Fixed-mount footage with a physical entry/exit boundary (and, for AC-09 acceptance, reference crossing labels).
